description: This file defines the EntityNotFoundException class, which is a custom exception used to indicate that a requested entity was not found in the database. It extends a global exception class and provides constructors for default and custom messages.

classes.name: EntityNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception class indicating that an entity was not found in the database. It extends SimpleBankingGlobalException and provides constructors for default and custom messages.

methods.name: EntityNotFoundException()
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a default message and error code indicating that the entity is not present in the database.
